questions.question: Name the five pairs of properties in this lesson.
questions.expected_answer: Hard or soft, stiff or flexible, strong or weak, light or heavy, and waterproof or absorbent.

questions.question: Describe a fair test to find out which material is waterproof and which is absorbent.
questions.expected_answer: Drip the same amount of water from a dropper onto pieces of each material of the same size. If the water stays as drops on top, the material is waterproof. If the water soaks in and makes a wet patch, the material is absorbent.

questions.question: Choose a material for a raincoat and a material for a towel, and explain your choices using properties.
questions.expected_answer: A raincoat should be made of plastic or treated fabric because it is waterproof and flexible. A towel should be made of cotton because it is absorbent and soft.
